description: This file implements an LDAP-based user authentication class for SuiteCRM, extending the base SugarAuthenticateUser class. It manages LDAP connections, user lookup, binding, authentication, and optionally creates local user records based on LDAP data.

classes.name: LDAPAuthenticateUser
classes.description: A class that provides LDAP authentication functionality by extending the SugarAuthenticateUser class, allowing login via LDAP, user creation from LDAP data, and handling LDAP connection details.

methods.name: authenticateUser
methods.description: Authenticates a user against LDAP by binding and searching the directory, returning the user ID if successful or an empty string if failed.

methods.name: getUserNameFilter
methods.description: Constructs an LDAP filter string for searching a user by username, optionally including additional filters.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new local user in SuiteCRM based on LDAP user info.

methods.name: loadUserOnLogin
methods.description: Coordinates LDAP login process, retrieves user ID, and initiates session loading.

methods.name: loginError
methods.description: Converts LDAP error codes into error strings, logs them, and indicates if an error occurred.

methods.name: ldap_rdn_lookup
methods.description: Performs LDAP bind and search to retrieve the distinguished name or bind attribute for a user, used in user authentication process.
